I sat down with Dmitri, a self-taught founder who went from having no experience to building a simple app that now makes $30k/month. This isn’t your average podcast startup story—it’s a deep dive into how to make money online by taking a side hustle to startup and turning it into a fully bootstrapped startup. Dmitri shares his full ai startup story, from idea to revenue, with a strong focus on using a smart seo growth strategy.

This saas founder interview covers how Dmitri managed to quit your job online, build a remote business, and grow his online business journey without outside funding. He talks about upwork hiring, smart startup seo techniques, and how creating a content moat helped attract a consistent stream of users.

If you're looking for a real passive income story, this conversation with a solo founder will inspire you. Dmitri's approach to building in public, launching consumer apps, and mastering app monetization is packed with insights. It’s a must-listen for fans of founder podcast content that goes beyond surface-level advice.
